deploybot: [migration-slot] Requesting maintenance window 04/02 02:00-03:00 UTC for migration m-5340 (compact backfill + index swap). Please ack within 10m or slot released. canaries=2.
Amalie: Plan: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY -> chunked backfill workers -> atomic rename under brief ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock. Backfill throttle default 300 r/s.
Ravi: Can we pin the canary nodes to tag release-3.2.1-dbpatch? Prevents feature flip before swap. If canary fails, we roll back pin to release-3.2.0.
SRE-oncall: I'll add live autotune: if replica_lag > 25s for 2m, throttle to 100 r/s and post to #eng-sre. Alert if p99 latency +15%.
Amalie: Runbook snippets:
```
-- preflight checks
SELECT now();
SELECT count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state='idle in transaction';
SELECT replay_lag FROM pg_stat_replication LIMIT 1;
-- progress
SELECT migration_id, phase, done_chunks, total_chunks FROM migration_tracker WHERE migration_id='m-5340';
```
Ravi: Rollback options: 1) abort before swap -> leave old index, no service impact; 2) after swap -> rename old index back (requires ~300-600ms lock). Documented in ops doc.
ops-bot: Holdpoint: manual-unpin required to proceed past canary. Auto-abort on failed preflight.
Amalie: Dropping sanitized SQL for quick review:
```
CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY users_email_idx_shadow ON users ((lower(email)));
-- worker fills chunks
-- swap: BEGIN; LOCK TABLE users IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE; ALTER INDEX users_email_idx_shadow RENAME TO users_email_idx; COMMIT;
```
SRE-oncall: Acked. I'll watch metrics during canary and post a go/no-go within 12m of rollout.
Ravi: Thanks — I'll be oncall for cutover and will paste smoke test results here. :thumbsup:
